events.text: He was educated at Magdalen College, Oxford.

events.object: Reserve Regiment of the 1st Life Guards

events.text: He served as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff.

events.text: His service as an aide-de-camp on the Personal Staff ended.

events.text: He served with the Territorial Army as a lieutenant in the Shropshire Yeomanry.

events.text: He served as captain in the 16th Battalion, London Regiment.

events.quote: then as captain in the 16th Battalion , London Regiment since 1929

events.text: He mobilised as Captain with the Royal Army Service Corps at the outbreak of World War II.

events.text: He became a director of Coutts & Company.

events.text: He remained with the firm until his retirement.
